programs.title: The Stoneman Murders
programs.desc: Mumbai of 1980s is terrorised by a serial killer who ruthlessly kills pavement dwellers in their sleep. A suspended police officer then decides to step in and conduct an investigation.

programs.title: Maine Pyar Kyon Kiya
programs.desc: A romantic comedy about a man named Samir who lies about being married to avoid the advances of his co-worker, Sonia. When Sonia finds out the truth, she starts dating Samir's friend Vicky. As Samir tries to win back Sonia's love, he faces humorous misunderstandings and complicated love triangles.

programs.title: C Kkompany
programs.desc: A comedy film about three friends who start a fictitious company called C Kkompany to extort money from the corrupt people in their neighborhood. However, their plan backfires when the news of their company spreads like wildfire, and they become the talk of the town. The movie showcases the hilarious consequences of their actions and how they try to redeem themselves in front of the public.

programs.title: Zakhmi Insan (dub) (dass Tamil)
programs.desc: Antony falls in love with Rajeswari who belongs to an upper caste family. When her father kills her sister for marrying a man from the lower caste, she decides to elope with Antony.
